claims.claim: It's original 650 Watts 144 cell direct Canadian used solar panel built to serve u
claims.evidence: The witness report shows multiple rectangular solar panels on a frame, but the panel model/ratings and any readable label (including wattage, cell count, or brand/origin) are not readable in the provided observations.

risks.risk: Total wattage may not be 650W (panel count and individual panel ratings are not shown/readable).
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the label/sticker on at least one panel showing wattage rating and model (and a shot showing the full array with the number of panels).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used multi-panel array with unknown total wattage; treat as lower-output/uncertain performance.

risks.risk: Cell count (144) and panel type may differ from what was claimed.
risks.proof: A readable label showing cell count/type, or a clear photo of the panel face where the cell layout can be counted/verified.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used solar panels (not guaranteed 144-cell).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it looks (micro-cracks, delamination, water ingress, hot spots) which are not visible from the provided angle.
risks.proof: Close-ups of panel corners/edges and junction box area, plus an output test (IV curve or at least measured voltage/current under sun/load).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used panels with possible degradation; assume reduced output.

risks.risk: Electrical/connector integrity may be compromised (cables, MC4s, junction box, bypass diodes).
risks.proof: Photos of junction boxes, connectors (MC4), cable condition, and any visible corrosion; ideally a continuity check clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing inspection/possible replacement of connectors/cables.

risks.risk: Frame/mounting and grounding may be unsafe or corroded (important for Rivers humidity/coastal conditions).
risks.proof: Photos of the full frame, mounting points, and grounding/earth connection; close-up of rust/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as without verified mounting/grounding quality; assume extra cost for reinforcement.

risks.risk: System compatibility is unknown (inverter/controller matching, presence/absence of charge controller and batteries).
risks.proof: Photos of the full system components (inverter/controller/battery bank if included) and model numbers; wiring diagram or clear shots of connections.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panels/array only (no guaranteed full system compatibility).

proof_requests: Clear, readable photo of the panel label/sticker (wattage, model, Voc/Vmp/Imp, cell count, serial/brand).
A shot showing the entire array so the exact number of panels can be counted.
Close-ups of junction boxes and connectors (MC4s), including any visible damage/corrosion.
Photos of frame/mounting hardware and the grounding/earthing setup.
If possible: a performance test under sun (measured voltage/current or IV curve) to confirm real output.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a multi-panel solar array on a frame, but the key details needed to price it correctly (readable wattage/cell count/model and condition specifics) are not available. Without those, even a worst-case price would be too speculative.
